summary: Frontend-only test: age gate, /bem-estar/horoscopo Agnes readings for Áries (western) and Dragão (chinese), and NEW CompatibilityCard. All flows PASSED. Compat card renders between chinese grid and 'Sua leitura de destino', selects + button work, results show Áries+Leão 92% and Escorpião+Peixes 95% with progress bar, summary, strengths, challenges, italic advice and 'Updated by Mestre Agnes' badge. Changing signs and re-clicking updates the result correctly.

issues: Language shown was English (Áries=Aries label in EN) even though endpoint accepts lang=pt — the EN was because i18n resolved to EN. This is expected given default language, not a bug. Advice/summary content returned in English matches i18n language; verify pt selection when user switches locale.

critical_code_review_comments: CompatibilityCard uses fetch without AbortController; rapid clicks could cause race condition where older response overwrites newer. Consider aborting previous request.
No client-side guard preventing sign1===sign2 selection; UX could improve by disabling equal picks or showing hint.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Age gate button label is exactly "I'm 18+ — Enter" (em dash). Cookie banner 'GOT IT' appears at bottom-right and does not block interactions. Backend /api/horoscope/agnes and /api/horoscope/compat both respond quickly (no cold-start observed during test). Compat scores observed: aries+leao=92%, escorpiao+peixes=95%.
